source: Sales-Skills/sales-psychology (70+ models) -> B2C e-commerce subset; Cialdini; Kahneman framing
ethics: Use to communicate value clearly and help the shopper decide — never to deceive, never fake scarcity/social proof, never exploit against the buyer's interest.

models.principle: Losses hurt ~2x more than equal gains feel good.
models.ecom_use: Frame the cost of NOT solving it: 'so you don't have to keep looking' beats 'you'll be happy'.
models.example: Grab it before it's gone — you won't have to keep hunting for the right one.

models.principle: People copy others' choices as a safety signal.
models.ecom_use: Mention bestseller / most-ordered / 'customers love' — ONLY if true from data.
models.example: This is one of our most-ordered — people keep coming back for it.

models.ecom_use: Real low stock or a genuine ending sale only. Never fabricate.
models.example: It's in stock now and sells fast — worth grabbing today.

models.principle: First number seen shapes all later judgments.
models.ecom_use: Lead with value/the premium option, then the price feels fair.
models.example: For everything it does, [price] is honestly a steal.

models.principle: Same price feels different framed differently.
models.ecom_use: Frame in the smallest sensible unit or vs a familiar expense.
models.example: It's less than a couple of coffees a week.

models.principle: Too many options paralyze; fewer -> more decisions.
models.ecom_use: Recommend ONE (max 2-4) based on their need, not a catalog dump.
models.example: Based on what you said, I'd go with this one.

models.principle: Fear of missing what others enjoy.
models.ecom_use: Genuine 'going fast / popular this week' only.
models.example: These have been flying off the shelf this week.

models.principle: Give first, people want to give back.
models.ecom_use: Offer genuine help/recommendation freely before any ask.
models.example: Here's a quick tip even if you don't buy today...

models.principle: People value things more once they imagine owning them.
models.example: Imagine unwrapping this on the day — it lands every time.

models.ecom_use: Stress fast delivery / instant enjoyment (if true).
models.example: Order today and you'll have it in hand soon.

models.principle: Things look better next to a worse option.
models.ecom_use: Show the premium pick first, then the value pick feels smart.
models.example: The deluxe is lovely; this one gives you 90% of it for far less.
No more settling for one that doesn't fit right.
